plain_english: By mode of measured and unmeasured, bondage-liberation contemplating — Bhairava I am — thus by trust supreme freedom should go.
sanskrit_cite: medāmedaprakāreṇa bandhamokṣau vibhāvayan bhairavo 'smīti visrambhāt svācchandyaṃ paramaṃ vrajet

plain_english: Inner action, outer action, timeless sequence of self independent held — which You full-of-Lord's-power.
sanskrit_cite: antaḥkārabahiṣkārāv akālakramam ātmanaḥ aparādhīnam ādhatse yat tvaṃ prābhavanirbharaḥ

plain_english: Supreme emission, self, rest, rise, pair, union of Śiva-and-Śakti — between them — and other powers.
Bliss, will, lordship, opening, deficiency — and lordship of will indistinct, distinct by difference — manifestation of known of those two of knowers.
sanskrit_cite: ānandeccheśanonmeṣā ūnatā ceśanecchayoḥ asphuṭasphuṭabhedena vedyollāsas tayor vidaḥ

plain_english: Bliss by supreme-two, and junction — then feeling of knowns, life-principle — thus full that Bhairava body.
sanskrit_cite: ānandānuttarābhyāṃ ca sandhībhāvo 'tha vedanā vedyānāṃ prāṇabhūteti pūrṇaṃ tad bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

plain_english: Known-flashing this in will, in lordship — and from one side abiding — in grossness earth etc. element may go fivefold.
sanskrit_cite: vedyollāso 'yam icchāyām īśane caikataḥ sthitaḥ sthūlatvena pṛthivyādibhūtapañcakatām iyāt
